name: 19060 · Garnet Valley, PA
findings: ZIP 19060 (Garnet Valley) has 38 nonprofit organizations. 20 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 17 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (47% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 19060 (Garnet Valley) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 19060 (Garnet Valley) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 63% of the typical level).
